# THE REACHABILITY CENSUS

*Generated by `tools/bohemia_reachability_census.py`. Do not hand-edit;
re-run it. Gate: `gates/reachability_gate.js`.*

**The question nothing in this repo could answer until now: of everything
we have built, what reaches the surface Paolo actually taps?**

Decided by BYTES, never by names — on 8/4 a name-based search of the same
kind produced four false alarms out of five, because names are a lane's
dialect and bytes are not. Each source is sampled for its own distinctive
content and counted as reaching a surface when those bytes appear in it
verbatim.

| surface | file | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| **SHOWN** | `slices/BOHEMIA_CITY_WORLD.html` | the walked world — what the RUN tab displays |
| **SHOWN** | `slices/BOHEMIA_ALPHA_0_9.html` | the shell and every other tab |
| **LOADED** | `slices/BOHEMIA_RUN_CURRENT.html` | loaded by the alpha and **never displayed** |

## THE COUNT

|---|---|---|

**276.2 MB of 279.3 MB** sampled does not reach the shown surface.

> **What `NO TRACE` honestly means:** no sampled bytes of this source appear
> verbatim in any surface. Strong evidence it does not ship — but not proof.
> A bank whose art is TRANSFORMED before shipping (re-encoded, recoloured,
> re-tiled) reads as NO TRACE while genuinely reaching him. Those are the
> interesting rows, which is why every source is named below instead of
> only counted. Argue with the list; do not take it on faith.
